title: Vagaja2023: Motor-imagery EEG during embodiment-primed MI-BCI training in VR
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings, with bipolar EMG, skin temperature and accelerometry, from 26 healthy volunteers performing cued left- versus right-hand motor imagery during MI-BCI training in immersive virtual reality. Participants were randomized to an embodiment-primed (virtual hand illusion) group or a non-embodied control group, each completing one session of 40 trials. The data were re-released in BIDS format via MOABB from the original Zenodo deposit.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 500 Hz from 32 active Ag/AgCl electrodes (actiCAP, LiveAmp 32, Brain Products) with BrainVision Recorder, plus 2 EMG and 4 misc channels. Each subject completed one lab session with cue-based left/right-hand motor imagery (20 trials per class, 10 s imagery/feedback window) in VR with visual feedback.
